title: Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements: A framework for quantum hypothesis testing and semidefinite optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.04061v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantum measurements are the means by which we recover messages encoded into quantum states. They are at the forefront of quantum hypothesis testing, wherein the goal is to perform an optimal measurement for arriving at a correct conclusion. Mathematically, a measurement operator is Hermitian with eigenvalues in [0,1]. By noticing that this constraint on each eigenvalue is the same as that imposed on fermions by the Pauli exclusion principle, we interpret every eigenmode of a measurement operator as an independent effective fermionic mode. Under this perspective, various objective functions in quantum hypothesis testing can be viewed as the total expected energy associated with these fermionic occupation numbers. translated_title: 费米-狄拉克热测量：量子假设检验与半定优化的框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.04061v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：量子测量是我们从量子态中恢复编码信息的手段。它们处于量子假设检验的前沿，其目标是通过执行最优测量来得出正确结论。数学上，测量算符是厄米矩阵，其特征值在[0,1]范围内。通过注意到每个特征值的这一约束与泡利不相容原理对费米子施加的约束相同，我们将测量算符的每个本征模式解释为一个独立的有效费米子模式。在此视角下，量子假设检验中的各种目标函数可以被视为与这些费米子占据数相关的总期望能量。通过固定温度并最小化总期望费米子自由能，我们发现在这些修正目标函数下的最优测量是费米-狄拉克热测量，其特征值...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将量子测量算符的特征值约束类比为费米子泡利原理的新框架，通过固定温度并最小化费米子自由能，推导出最优测量为费米-狄拉克热测量，从而为量子假设检验和半定优化提供了统一的理论工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a framework that maps quantum measurement operator eigenvalue constraints to fermionic Pauli exclusion, deriving optimal measurements as Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements by fixing temperature and minimizing fermionic free energy, offering a unified tool for quantum hypothesis testing and semidefinite optimization.
